A Principal Magistrate and two social workers, at least one of whom is a woman

Detention in every case until adulthood

s: The offence of trafficking of persons, widened by the Criminal Law Amendment Act 2013, is now dealt with under which provision?

s: Which of the following correctly describes the 2019 amendment to the POCSO Act?
o: It introduced the death penalty for aggravated penetrative assault and prescribed a minimum punishment of 20 years
It removed the punishment of imprisonment for aggravated penetrative assault
It made all POCSO offences compoundable
It reduced the minimum punishment to 7 years
x: The 2019 amendment provided for the death penalty in aggravated penetrative assault cases and prescribed a minimum punishment of 20 years. The POCSO Rules were framed in 2020.

s: Under the POCSO Act, below what age is a person's consent legally irrelevant?
x: POCSO fixes the relevant age at 18 years, so apparent consent below 18 is irrelevant.

s: Which one of the following correctly describes the trial framework under the POCSO Act?
o: Trial before the High Court within one month without compensation provisions
In-camera trial, with investigation targeted within two months and trial within one year
Open trial within two years after investigation by any police station
Trial only before a Juvenile Justice Board within six months
x: POCSO provides for in-camera proceedings, investigation within two months and trial within one year; special courts also address compensation and rehabilitation.

s: Which provisions of the POCSO Act place the burden of proof on the accused?
x: Sections 29–30 raise a presumption against the accused; Section 19 is mandatory reporting and Section 22 is false complaints.

s: On which date did the POCSO Act come into force?
x: POCSO came into force on 14 November 2012; the 2019 amendment set a 10-year minimum for penetrative sexual assault.

s: What is the legal age of marriage in India, which should not be confused with the age of consent under POCSO?
o: 18 years for women and 21 years for men
21 years for women and 18 years for men
18 years for women and 18 years for men
16 years for women and 18 years for men
x: The age of consent under POCSO is 18 years. The legal marriage age referred to here is 18 years for women and 21 years for men.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the POCSO Act, 2012?
o: It excludes stringent punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault.
It includes capital punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault.
It provides for child-friendly special courts.
x: POCSO (amended 2019) has stringent punishment, including death, for aggravated penetrative sexual assault; it also has special courts and mandatory reporting.

s: Which of the following is a legal provision of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012?
o: Internal Complaints Committees in workplaces with 10 or more employees
Mandatory crèche facility in establishments with 50 or more employees
x: POCSO makes reporting of child sexual offences mandatory. Maintenance Tribunals belong to the Senior Citizens Act, ICCs to POSH, and crèches to the Maternity Benefit amendment.

s: What is the status of the POCSO Act after the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the IPC from 1 July 2024?
o: Was subsumed entirely into the BNS
Was merged with the Juvenile Justice Act
Continues as a separate special law
x: The IPC was replaced by the BNS from 1 July 2024, but POCSO continues as a separate special law.

s: Which of the following is NOT an offence specifically identified under the POCSO Act?
o: Child marriage as an independent POCSO offence
x: POCSO identifies penetrative and non-penetrative sexual assault, aggravated forms, sexual harassment and child pornography. Child marriage is not listed as an independent POCSO offence in this classification.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Jaya Jaitly Task Force?
o: It linked its recommendation with lowering MMR and IMR.
It recommended raising women's minimum marriage age from 18 to 20 years.
It recommended raising women's minimum marriage age from 18 to 21 years.
x: The Task Force recommended raising women's minimum marriage age from 18 to 21, not 20, to bring down MMR and IMR.

s: Which additional conduct was specifically addressed by the 2019 amendment to the POCSO Act?
o: Failure to attend school up to 14 years
Employing a child in all forms of domestic work
Giving chemicals to hasten sexual maturity
Permitting marriage below the statutory age
x: The 2019 amendment introduced punishment for giving chemicals to a child to hasten sexual maturity.

s: Under the 2019 POCSO amendment, what is the minimum punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault?
x: Since 2019 the minimum is 20 years for aggravated and 10 years for penetrative sexual assault.

s: Under Section 19 of the POCSO Act, failure to report an offence is punishable with imprisonment up to how long?
x: Section 19 makes reporting mandatory; failure attracts up to 6 months and/or fine.

s: Which Section of the POCSO Act makes false complaints punishable, except those made in good faith?
x: Section 22 punishes false complaints made to harm someone; Section 19 is on mandatory reporting and Sections 29-30 on presumption.

s: Under the POCSO (Amendment) Act, 2019, what is the minimum punishment for penetrative sexual assault?
x: The 2019 amendment raised the minimum for penetrative sexual assault to 10 years and for aggravated penetrative assault to 20 years.
